snippet.title: Neurocracy Release Trailer
snippet.description:
NEUROCRACY is a sci-fi hypertext game that invites you to explore the Wikipedia of the year 2049. Then a murder happens and the editing war begins! Find clues, draw connections, compare notes with others, and solve the murder across ten weekly episodes.

- Website: https://neurocracy.site
- Store page: https://pyrofoux.itch.io/neurocracy
- Developer: https://playthroughline.com
- Discord: https://discord.gg/9ghXDan

- Trailer created by Samantha Mackenzie Greer (https://sammgreercom.wordpress.com/)
- Music by Acid Barrett (https://virlyn.bandcamp.com) & Former Lamb (https://soundcloud.com/former-lamb)
